encode_string_to_characters: encode a string into space-separated characters using the Characters BPE encoder
decode_characters_to_string: decode space-separated characters back into the original string using the Characters BPE decoder
register_characters_bpe: register the Characters class as a BPE encoder with the name 'characters' in fairseq
escape_spaces_in_text: escape space characters in text using the SPACE_ESCAPE constant before encoding
summarize_characters_encoder: summarize the Characters BPE encoder that splits text into individual characters with space escaping
